answer.justification: The rider's total pay-per-use cost is $11.73, while the membership total cost is $31.35. The break-even point is approximately 10.21 rides, meaning the membership is cheaper for more than 10 rides. The rider's pay-per-use cost is based on the single ride pricing for classic bikes ($1.00 unlock + $0.19/min) and ebikes ($1.00 unlock + $0.49/min). The membership cost includes the monthly pass price ($29.95) and additional per-minute rates for ebikes ($0.17/min) and classic bikes ($0.17/min with 45 minutes free).
